summary: English virtual-only development review passed after nonoverlapping tool layout, compact report controls, precise final-assay wording, robust post-drag choices and stale-feedback fixes. External comprehension, hardware/protocol and AUD-10 delivery remain separate.

G01.notes: Three goals link controlled test design, four observation/claim pairs and limited inference to original written explanations. Completion does not grade understanding.

G02.notes: Four assays address different targets on separate portions. Supplied positive/negative controls and optional matched preparation are labeled; shortcuts do not fill observations. Portions are not independent biological replicates.

G03.notes: Reviewed primary Pratt 2011 methods and institutional cross-check. Heated Benedict detects reducing sugars including lactose, iodine starch, Biuret peptide bonds, and Sudan IV paper staining is interpreted after rinsing. Synthetic profiles are not empirical food measurements.

G04.notes: Sensitivity, food-color interference, shortened treatment, synthetic quantities and negative-result limits appear beside the bench and in reports/resources. No exact concentration or named food is inferred.

G05.notes: Students place the sample/reagent at the actual specimen, grip the tube with tongs and move it to a bath, stain/rinse paper, then classify visible observations and claims. Wrong placement and corrections have consequences.

G06.notes: Inspected initial, each assay intermediate/final, phone and tablet states. Glass, meniscus, increased liquid, precipitate, paper and dye support interpretation. Shared scene/target coordinates and adjacent nonoverlapping tools survive scroll/resize/reload.

G07.notes: Seeded sample profile and shuffled choices remain stable within the attempt and on reload. Reference identities and meaningful assay order remain intact; position does not indicate the answer.

G08.notes: Reviewed the full English pathway, error feedback, questions, report and handouts for ninth-grade language. Indicator, controls, reducing sugar, peptide bond, basic pH and sensitivity are explained in context. External comprehension remains pending.

G09.notes: Required reasoned prediction and control/portion design are recorded before apparatus/results. Initial plan remains preserved. Heat/rinse gates prevent premature interpretations; predictions need not agree with the outcome.
